note: From the 2026-08-31 pass that opened Kamakura off Kanagawa prefecture's hundred notable trees. The published page runs 4 of 6 trees behind a small temple fee, over the one-third line, and the fix per CLAUDE.md is free trees ADDED rather than good ones removed. These are the candidates for that.

leads.name: Kaido of Myohonji
leads.why: One of Kamakura's three great crabapples alongside Kosokuji's and Anyoin's, and Myohonji has no entrance fee, which is exactly what the paid ratio needs. Not on Kanagawa's hundred-notable-trees list, so it needs its own two sources and a coordinate.

leads.name: Kaido of Anyoin
leads.why: The third of the three great crabapples. Anyoin charges a small fee, so it does not help the ratio, but it completes the set.

leads.name: Camphor of Joraku-ji
leads.why: Joraku-ji at Ofuna is free and holds old trees. Unverified: needs measurements and a second source.

leads.name: Byakushin of Engakuji
leads.why: Engakuji, the second of the five great Zen temples, has old junipers of the same tradition as Kenchoji's. Charges a fee. Needs measurements.
